tasks_completed.description: Fix --day flag parser bug in generate-and-deploy.sh
tasks_completed.changes: Added 'shift' immediately after 'PLAN_ID="$1"' on line 35 to consume the positional plan-id argument; changed 'while [ "$#" -gt 1 ]' to 'while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]' on line 40 so the option loop processes the remaining args including a possible trailing --day argv.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause was that the option parser used 'while [ "$#" -gt 1 ]' AND 'case "$1"' with no prior shift, so $1 remained the plan-id ('test-plan-id', etc.) which fell through to the '*) Unknown option' catch-all and exited 1. Fix: shift past the plan-id first, then loop while args remain (>0).

tasks_completed.description: AC9 — demoted-primary state machine: drop old primary unless explicitly listed
tasks_completed.rationale: Added audit_demoted_primaries() in semantic_lint.py. For each meal_slot whose existing primary differs from update primary, AND whose old primary is NOT explicitly listed (by normalized name) in incoming alternatives[], emit stderr audit line: '[save] demoted-primary policy: Day {N} {meal}: dropped "{old-primary-name}"; retained alternatives: [{list}]'. Save does NOT auto-preserve the old primary — the existing merge_agent_slots() does whole-slot replacement, so the old primary disappears unless the agent explicitly retained it. Wired via _emit_demoted_primary_audit_for_meals() in _merge_existing_slots() (called only when agent_file.stem == 'meals'). Verified live with two payloads: (a) replace Day 12 lunch primary with new item + empty alternatives → audit line emitted, saved file shows new primary and empty alternatives (old primary gone); (b) replace primary but include old primary in alternatives → NO audit line, saved file retains old primary as alt (agent's explicit choice respected). Both data states restored after verification.

tasks_completed.description: AC13(b) — shape-normalizer _normalize_to_canonical_record(item, shape) + inverse _denormalize() with lossless round-trip
tasks_completed.rationale: Added module constants SHAPE_MEALS_NESTED='meals_nested' and SHAPE_FLAT_OPTIONAL='flat_optional'. Forward path: _normalize_meals_slot() splits a meals slot {primary, alternatives[]} into an ordered list of canonical records — primary first then alternatives in source-order, each carrying _canonical_role ('primary'|'alternative'|'flat'), _canonical_slot (meal_type or None), and _canonical_alt_index (int or None). _normalize_flat_item() maps a flat-shape item dict to a single canonical record. Inverse path: _denormalize_meals() rebuilds the slot by (a) emitting a 'primary' key only when a primary record is present and (b) emitting an 'alternatives' key only when at least one alternative record exists — preserving the source absence of 'alternatives' when meals slots have only primary (per meals.schema.json which marks 'alternatives' as optional). _strip_canonical_fields() removes the three bookkeeping fields. _denormalize() inverse for flat shape is the strip alone. Unknown shape raises ValueError naming the two valid constants. The canonical record format means W5's check_cross_domain_dedup() (scripts/lib/semantic_lint.py) can be retrofitted to call _normalize_to_canonical_record() once and compare shape-agnostically; W5's handoff notes confirm this upgrade is deferred to a follow-up.
